name: My New Band Believe
label: Rough Trade
lede: A band name written down in a fever in a Chinese hotel room, a lineup that changes by the song, and the acoustic record that Pitchfork scored 8.4.

eras.title: Four kids from the BRIT School
eras.text: Cameron Picton, Geordie Greep, Matt Kwasniewski-Kelvin and Morgan Simpson all went to the BRIT School, and their band, black midi, grew up in a Brixton pub. Picton played bass and sang, and by the end of 2019 the band had a Rough Trade deal and a Mercury Prize nomination.

years.h: First gig: The Windmill, Brixton, supporting Leg Puppy
years.p: [[black midi|4afbef0a-05ee-4551-b0e0-f1f1870d8f1c]] played their first show at a south London pub that became the hub of what the press called the Windmill scene.
years.xp: The four members ([[Geordie Greep|6ca6f49f-41f3-49ae-8403-44d07bc6f564]], Matt Kwasniewski-Kelvin, [[Morgan Simpson|c3136ee8-f5b8-491e-acaa-60dda80e8eb1]] and Cameron Picton) all attended the BRIT School. Wikipedia dates the band's formation to 2016, with Greep and Kwasniewski-Kelvin recruiting Simpson on drums and Picton joining on bass afterward.

years.src: KEXP: black midi · Wikipedia: Black Midi
years.h: A KEXP session in Reykjavik does the touring for them
years.p: black midi played Iceland Airwaves on November 9, 2018, and KEXP's recording of the set spread on YouTube before they had an album out.
years.xp: The band had put out its debut single, 'bmbmbm', on June 8, 2018 on [[Dan Carey|41b34054-f491-4991-9495-477617fdc81a]]'s Speedy Wunderground label. Wikipedia says the KEXP session 'became popular on YouTube', which exposed the band to listeners abroad.

years.h: Schlagenheim, on Rough Trade, then a Mercury nomination
years.p: The debut album followed a January 2019 signing to Rough Trade, the label that would later put out Picton's own band.
years.xp: Wikipedia records the album as nominated for the 2019 Mercury Prize and lists an 82 on Metacritic.

eras.title: Three albums, one fewer guitarist
eras.text: The band kept going with Kwasniewski-Kelvin away, and Picton's job on record widened well past bass. Cavalcade and Hellfire are the two albums where you can hear it.

years.h: Matt Kwasniewski-Kelvin steps back from black midi
years.p: The band said the guitarist had been taking time off for mental health reasons and would not be on new material.
years.xp: He still contributed as a composer to some songs on Cavalcade, released May 26, 2021, with touring players [[Seth Evans|f97a5613-eb6f-44bf-a238-4adf26aa7b06]] and Kaidi Akinnibi in the sessions. Wikipedia lists Picton on bass, vocals, flute, keyboards and guitar for that record.

years.h: Hellfire is their highest UK chart placement
years.p: The third and last black midi album entered at No. 22 in the UK and No. 139 on the US chart, per Wikipedia.

eras.title: Nobody says the word breakup
eras.text: A sick bassist wrote a band name down, sold his first solo mixtapes at merch tables, and watched black midi go quiet without a funeral. By the end of 2024 Greep and Simpson had their own projects.

years.big: You got to suffer to have nice things
years.src: Paste · The Quietus · Rough Trade: My New Band Believe announce
years.h: The band name arrives in a Xi'an hotel room
years.p: Picton told Paste the phrase 'My New Band Believe' came to him in a food-poisoning haze after eating street crayfish.
years.xp: According to The Quietus, he wrote down a string of phrases while delirious on black midi's tour of China, and one of them stuck. Rough Trade's own announcement describes him 'delirious in a Chinese hotel room' when the imagery hit.

years.h: Camera Picture: a mixtape sold only at shows
years.p: Picton started playing solo under that name and selling single-track mixtapes named for their running times, the first being 44m50s.
years.xp: DIY reports it appeared on an April 2024 US tour supporting [[Black Country, New Road|e9403d9c-329b-4108-a26f-564159d441d9]]. Wikipedia says the mixtapes (44m50s, 36m33s and 24m56s) were sold exclusively at gigs to fund studio costs; Picton said they take the pressure off releasing music officially.

years.src: Wikipedia: Black Midi · Wikipedia: Geordie Greep
years.h: Geordie Greep tells Instagram Live black midi is 'indefinitely over'
years.p: Picton confirmed it on Twitter, saying the band had agreed not to say anything about 'breaking up'; management called it a hiatus.
years.xp: A statement to The Quietus said the band agreed to a break and some solo work, with the black midi door left open. Greep released his solo album The New Sound on October 4, 2024, produced by [[Seth Evans|f97a5613-eb6f-44bf-a238-4adf26aa7b06]], and [[Morgan Simpson|c3136ee8-f5b8-491e-acaa-60dda80e8eb1]] went on the road with [[Nala Sinephro|46a4b150-be30-44b3-a337-e06a72657d33]].

eras.title: Eight days, one song
eras.text: The project got a name, a first single and a first show. The band was never meant to be a fixed lineup, so nobody was surprised when the players changed.

years.h: Lecture 25: someone else's words, eight days start to finish
years.p: Picton adapted Dennis Cooper's Lecture 1970 into about half the song's lyrics; Jack Shep directed the video.
years.xp:
Clash reports the song was conceived, recorded, mixed, mastered and filmed in a 'breathless eight-day streak'. Picton played guitar and sang, with Josh Finerty on bass, King David Ike-Elechi on drums and Seth Evans on piano; Evans and Margo Broom produced, at RAK Studios.

Picton said he hadn't written a proper song since before Christmas and figured this was a good way to get moving again.

years.p: Picton opened a US run there solo, with the third Camera Picture mixtape, 24m56s, sold only at the dates.
years.xp: Rough Trade's announcement listed the Chicago date first, and had him opening for [[Lankum|0898de3e-7045-478b-a5af-c7de9c66c86e]] on select West Coast shows in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

eras.title: Eleven studios, eight songs
eras.text: The debut arrived on Rough Trade in April, after a year of the acoustic guitar tracks being stacked and the strings being added. Three months before it, the death of his old bandmate Matt Kwasniewski-Kelvin was announced.

years.p: His family said he died after a long battle with his mental health, and Rough Trade shared its condolences.
years.xp: Picton told The Quietus that talking about Matt is an emotional thing and that he spent a lot of time looking back at old photos of the two of them.

years.src: Rough Trade: Love Story · NME · Wikipedia: My New Band Believe (album)
years.h: Love Story, with a video by Parker Corey
years.p: The first album track released as a single has strings arranged by [[Kiran Leonard|5dfe107b-b9c2-42c4-a2e6-34f056bd4563]]; Rough Trade says Picton wrote it quickly in early 2024.
years.xp: NME says the piano line was improvised in the clock tower at St. Pancras station. The month before, on February 17, Picton had announced the album with a non-album single, 'Numerology', which Wikipedia says is on the deluxe editions.

years.src: Wikipedia: My New Band Believe (album) · The Label · NME · The Line of Best Fit
yt: Cameron Picton on the recording process
years.h: The debut: eight acoustic songs, dozens of players, Pitchfork 8.4
years.p: Guests include [[Kiran Leonard|5dfe107b-b9c2-42c4-a2e6-34f056bd4563]], [[Steve Noble|ac3495e0-c927-48e6-9499-de8c2c3c8dd8]], Caius Williams and members of caroline; Sam Sodomsky's Pitchfork review scored it 8.4.
years.xp:
Wikipedia says recording ran across 29 days between August 2024 and December 2025, in 11 London studios with 9 engineers. The band recorded songs live several times and Picton assembled the master versions from those takes rather than making demos.

NME's Patrick Clarke called it a masterpiece, and The Guardian's Alexis Petridis gave it four stars. Picton told The Line of Best Fit: 'There's no cynicism or irony or anything like that. I'm very serious about it.'

q: It's basically a band that doesn't really have any set members.
years.src: Northern Transmissions · Rough Trade: Love Story · The Line of Best Fit
years.h: A band with no set members goes on the road
years.p: UK dates ran April 28 to May 6 and North American dates May 29 to June 7, with several already sold out by March.
years.xp: Rough Trade listed a Rewire festival date in The Hague on April 11 and Green Man on August 21 to 23. The Line of Best Fit names King David Ike-Elechi, Steve Noble and Caius Williams among the live players.
